urdu.long_meaning: Surya (سوریا) سنسکرت زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم سوریا، سورج ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

persian.name: سوریا

hindi.name: सूर्य

arabic.name: سُورْيَا
arabic.long_meaning: Surya (سُورْيَا) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة السنسكريتية، ومعناه الأساسي سُورْيَا، الشَّمْس. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.

faq.a: Surya is associated with the Sanskrit form سُورْيَا, whose core sense is surya; sun (sanskrit).

faq.q: What is the origin of Surya?
faq.a: Surya is associated with Sanskrit. Surya is Sanskrit सूर्य (sūrya), meaning 'sun'. It is used as a male given name in Indonesia and South Asia.
No — the underlying form is Sanskrit, not Arabic.
Surya can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Sanskrit-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Surya should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Sūrya is a Sanskrit word, not a Quranic Arabic form.

faq.q: What does Surya mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Surya is rendered سوریا and carries the sense سوریا، سورج.

faq.q: What does Surya mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Surya is rendered سوریا and carries the sense سوریا، خورشید.
A romanized syllable approximation is su-rya. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Surya?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Surya, surya. Script forms are سوريا, سوریا, سُورْيَا, सूर्य.

faq.q: Is Surya a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
